# Synthetic control-flow diagnostic

These artifacts were hand authored for offline evaluator tests. No model was
called. The source describes a fictional queue, not PageIndex or any historical
baseline topic. The response intentionally includes “직접 써봤다.” and an unsupported
“73% faster”; the repair replaces only that implicated section.

All four labels share one frozen packet, initial text, declared no-model identity
and three-call ceiling. One-shot/packet outputs are replayed and audited, not
regenerated. Full replay exercises drafting, validation and a supplied repair,
without media selection. It cannot establish article quality or model reliability.

JSON files use LF through a local `.gitattributes` rule because the manifest binds
their exact SHA-256 bytes. Do not edit an artifact without updating its capture
hashes. Model tokens, billing and runtime were not measured. Human scores and meme
fit are pending. Real captures require the metadata documented in
`docs/editorial-evaluation.md` and must not be substituted with current pages.
